name: "Freezer-Friendly" English Muffin Breakfast Sandwiches with Egg, Sausage & Cheese (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 325°F. Coat a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking spray and set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine, then pour into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle sausage evenly over egg mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp whole milk
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until eggs are set in the center, 18-22 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour. (The eggs will continue to firm up as they cool.)
When the eggs are cool, cut into 12 squares.
Split English muffins in half. Top half with a sausage-egg square and slice of cheese, then close sandwiches with remaining halves.

STORING: Wrap each sandwich in parchment paper, then transfer to a storage container or resealable bag and place in the freezer for up to 1 month. 
REHEATING: For best results, thaw sandwich(es) in the fridge overnight. Remove parchment from the sandwich and heat in a microwave or toaster oven until cheese is melted and sandwich is warmed through. Enjoy!
